description: This PHP source file defines the ViewLocationController class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. The controller manages the view logic for location data, including pre-render setup that initializes a Vue.js component with country data retrieved from a service. It also manages permissions related to location data.

classes.name: ViewLocationController
classes.description: A controller class extending BaseAdminController responsible for managing location views, preparing Vue.js components with country data and setting permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with country data and permissions before rendering the view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Determines data groups required for capability checks, specifically for 'locations'.
